A foot, the catchplate and part of the bow of a Roman copper alloy bow brooch. The bow is broadly rectangular in cross section. The foot has a single horizontal incised line at the tip. Just above is an inscribed 'A'. The bow tapers slightly before expanding towards the foot which has a flat base.
